name: Archive Studio Elementor
author: wpcraftnet

sections.description: Create stunning blog archive pages with Eliminator using Grid, Masonry, and Portrait layouts—fully customisable styles and controls. ** Description ** This add-ons includes 4 professionally designed archive layouts: ✔️ Grid Layout ✔️ Masonry Layout ✔️ Portrait Layout ✔️ Portrait Card Layout Each layout includes dedicated controllers and styling options, giving full control over archive pages spacing, typography, images, pagination more. This plugin also supports advanced pagination styles, letting users define how archive navigation appears—classic pagination, load more, infinite scroll, numbers, next/prev buttons, etc.
